evidence.label: mcp-go-sql-string-built (medium/low)
evidence.detail: Listed, not deducted: this check is new and its precision has not been measured, so it is shown for review and scores nothing. A SQL statement is assembled by string building — fmt.Sprintf, or concatenation with something that is not a constant — and passed straight to a query method. A value built in can always be sent as an argument after the statement instead (database/sql, pgx and sqlx all take them), and a caller-supplied one is SQL injection; an identifier (a table or column name) cannot be an argument and must be validated or quoted. This check cannot tell which the built part is, so it is listed for review, not deducted.

evidence.label: authentication_model
evidence.detail: stdio transport: the client launches the server as a subprocess, so the OS process boundary is the auth boundary — `03` §4 does not penalise absent auth here

evidence.label: transport_security
evidence.detail: declared transport: stdio — launched as a subprocess by the client, so the security boundary is the client process, not a network port (`03` §4)

evidence.label: secret_handling
evidence.detail: detect-secrets matched 9 credential-shaped string(s), every one from a keyword or entropy heuristic (Hex High Entropy String, Secret Keyword). Those flag placeholders, variable names and content hashes as readily as credentials, so they do not establish the committed credential `03` §4's 0 asserts, and this sub-check is not scored; Secret Keyword at cli/internal/cli/doctor.go:592; Secret Keyword at cli/internal/cli/platform_cli_test.go:427; Secret Keyword at cli/internal/cliutil/secret_funnel.go:148; Secret Keyword at cli/internal/cliutil/secret_funnel_test.go:139; Secret Keyword at cli/internal/config/config.go:516; Secret Keyword at cli/internal/config/config.go:660; Secret Keyword at cli/internal/config/config.go:809; Secret Keyword at cli/internal/config/config_perms_test.go:30; Hex High Entropy String at cli/internal/platform/testdata/receipt-status-golden.json:2

evidence.label: authorization_granularity
evidence.detail: no tool registration was recognised anywhere in the source. An MCP server registers tools by definition, so this is a gap in our detection rather than a server with none, and `03` §4's threshold cannot be applied to it.

evidence.label: recency
evidence.detail: last commit 6 day(s) before 2026-11-24

evidence.label: issue_responsiveness
evidence.detail: median over 45 issue(s) in the last 6 months: 25.1 day(s) to first maintainer comment

evidence.label: release_cadence
evidence.detail: released 6 day(s) ago (by releases), inside `03` §5's 30-day window

evidence.label: bus_factor
evidence.detail: this repository's 12-month history is longer than the bounded walk `04` §7 performs, and the authors found so far span more than one of `03` §5's bands. A limit of ours, not a finding about the server.

evidence.label: repository_signals
evidence.detail: `03` §5 scores this by quartile WITHIN the server's category, which needs a distribution across every scanned server and so cannot be computed while scanning one. It is a post-pass over the crawl and that pass does not exist yet.
